name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Adding a custom ID here will replace the default custom ID.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Enter your additional, custom classes here for additional styling options in your css.

name: graph_title
label: Graph Title
help_text: Enter the title for the bar graph.

name: bar_data
label: Bar Data
help_text: Configure the bars for the graph.

children.name: bar_value
children.label: Bar Value
children.help_text: Enter the numeric value for this bar. The height will be calculated relative to the maximum value.

children.name: use_gradient
children.label: Use Gradient Colors
children.help_text: If enabled, bars will use a gradient color scheme. If disabled, all bars will use the same color.

children.name: start_color
children.label: Start Color (First Bar)
children.help_text: Color for the first bar (or all bars if gradient is disabled).

children.name: end_color
children.label: End Color (Last Bar)
children.help_text: Color for the last bar (only used if gradient is enabled).

children.name: max_value
children.label: Maximum Value
children.help_text: The maximum value for scaling bar heights. Bars will be scaled relative to this value.

children.name: show_grid
children.label: Show Grid Lines
children.help_text: Display horizontal grid lines in the background.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Set custom margin and padding for the module.
